units.source_text: 薰中纳言派人送信来了。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, sent someone with a letter.

units.source_text: 大女公子说：“我今天身体不好。”

en.t: The elder princess said, "I am not feeling well today."
She had her ladies-in-waiting reply on her behalf.

units.source_text: 侍女们都有怨言：“叫人代笔多么失礼！

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting all complained, "How rude to have someone else write for her!

units.source_text: 周年忌辰过后，丧服该脱下了。

en.t: After the first anniversary of mourning had passed, it was time to put off their mourning clothes.

units.source_text: 两女公子当初预计：父亲死后片刻也不能生存。

en.t: At first, the two princesses had thought they could not live even a moment after their father's death.

units.source_text: 却终于糊里糊涂地过了一年，真乃意外的苦命生涯。

en.t: Yet somehow they had drifted through an entire year, a wretched life they had never expected.

units.source_text: 想到这里，便伤心哭泣，教人看了实在难过。

en.t: Thinking of this, they wept in grief, and it was truly painful for others to see.

units.source_text: 大女公子一年来穿惯了黑色丧服，现在换上淡墨色衣服，那容姿非常优雅。

en.t: The elder princess, who had grown used to wearing black mourning robes for a year, now changed into pale gray robes, and her appearance was very elegant.

units.source_text: 二女公子年纪正轻，更是艳丽无比。

en.t: The younger princess was just at the bloom of youth and was even more incomparably beautiful.

units.source_text: 二女公子洗头发时，大女公子来帮她。

en.t: When the younger princess washed her hair, the elder princess came to help her.

units.source_text: 她细看妹妹的容颜，觉得非常姣美，使她忘记了人世忧患。

en.t: She looked closely at her younger sister's face and found it so beautiful that it made her forget the sorrows of the world.

units.source_text: 她想：“倘能成全我的私愿，让妹妹嫁了那人，那人近看之下决不会不满意吧。”

en.t: She thought, "If only my private wish could be fulfilled and my sister married that man, surely he would not be dissatisfied once he saw her up close."

units.source_text: 她觉得此事有把握，心甚欣喜。

en.t: She felt there was hope in the matter and was deeply pleased.

units.source_text: 二女公子除了这姐姐以外，别无保护人。

en.t: Apart from this elder sister, the younger princess had no one else to protect her.

units.source_text: 大女公子怀着父母之心照顾她。

en.t: The elder princess cared for her with the heart of a parent.
